items.title: 2026-022: Critical vulnerabilities in Nginx
items.summary: CERT-EU flags five NGINX flaws patched by F5 allowing unauthenticated remote code execution as the worker process; a PoC exists for CVE-2026-123007, no in-the-wild exploitation yet. Patch internet-facing instances first.

items.title: 2026-020: Critical Vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway
items.summary: Citrix patched 28 memory flaws in NetScaler ADC and Gateway; CVE-2026-120868 affects every deployment including default configurations, with unpredictable behaviour and DoS impact. No exploitation reported.

items.title: Switzerland Confirms AI-Assisted Cyberattacks Breached Critical Infrastructure Operators
items.summary: Switzerland's cyber agency confirmed attackers using AI agents breached systems in four of five confirmed cases, three targeting critical infrastructure operators, two successful, with no major disruption reported.

items.title: Microsoft: Hackers in China, N Korea using ARTEX AI tool to break into global tech systems
items.summary: Microsoft reports Chinese and North Korean state-linked actors using the ARTEX agentic offensive framework to automate familiar attack techniques against global tech systems, potentially breaching weak defences in minutes.

items.title: Daily summary - 26.11.2026 (CERT.at)
items.summary: CERT.at's daily report notes Italian and Swiss warnings on autonomous AI-driven attacks against critical infrastructure and a Palo Alto Networks 'Fragnesia' PAN-OS flaw exploited in chained attacks.

items.title: Phishing attempt against a Hungarian financial services provider
items.originalTitle: 2026. 11. 26. Phishing kísérlet egy magyar pénzügyi szolgáltatónál A napokban egy magyar pénzügyi szolgáltatót a szokásostól eltérő phising kísérlet érte.
items.summary: Hungary's NKI reports an unusual phishing attempt targeting a Hungarian financial services provider in recent days.

items.title: 2026-021: High Severity Vulnerability in Java SE and OpenJDK
items.summary: Oracle and OpenJDK fixed CVE-2026-114938, a high-severity flaw that can lead to unauthenticated RCE under certain conditions. CERT-EU advises prioritising internet-facing Java applications.

items.title: In 2027, “the agent did it” stops being an excuse
items.summary: SailPoint research finds 79% of enterprises run AI agents in production while only 2% have identity security controls designed for them, with regulators, boards and insurers set to demand accountability in 2027.

items.title: Unpatched Cacti Zero-Day Enables RCE in Just Four HTTP Requests via Guest Access
items.summary: A PoC zero-day in the open-source Cacti network monitoring tool (dubbed 4HTTP2SHELL/4HTTP2ROOT) allows unauthenticated RCE via guest access in four HTTP requests; no CVE assigned yet.

items.title: AI raises new questions about what penetration testing proves
items.summary: CREST research finds 81% of threat-led penetration testing providers use AI beyond experimentation, raising questions about assurance, control and what a pentest actually proves, notably in financial services.

items.title: Fake paid expert interviews impersonate brands to steal Google logins
items.summary: The 'GoodGuys' phishing campaign impersonates Google, Nvidia, Accenture and SpaceX with fake paid expert interview and webinar invitations to steal corporate Google and Okta credentials.

items.title: Remus malware steals Gmail messages via fake Google Sheets extension
items.summary: The Remus infostealer uses a malicious Chrome extension posing as a Google Sheets add-on to exfiltrate Gmail messages, a capability marketed by its operators as a Gmail zero-day.

items.title: North Korea-Linked PolinRider Poisons Over 7,600 GitHub Repositories to Spread Malware
items.summary: North Korea-linked PolinRider poisoned over 7,600 GitHub repositories with a Python loader hidden in utils packages or conftest.py, with activity possibly dating to February 2025.

items.title: Wyoming uranium operation shuts down after cyberattack
items.summary: Peninsula Energy shut down its Wyoming uranium operation after a cyberattack affected plant and wellfield control systems; no restart date has been given.

items.title: OpenAI and Cisco unveil AI-based Linux defence tool

items.summary: OpenAI and Cisco jointly developed Shirudo, an open-source Linux runtime environment aimed at defending systems, according to Hungary's NKI.

items.title: Rackspace shuts down Spot cloud platform after security incident
items.originalTitle: 2026. 11. 26. Biztonsági incidens után leállítja a Rackspace a Spot felhőplatformját A Rackspace bejelentette, hogy megszünteti Rackspace Spot nevű felhőszolgáltatását, miután hackereknek sikerült ho…
items.summary: Rackspace is discontinuing its Rackspace Spot cloud service after attackers gained access, per NKI reporting. Customers of the platform should plan migration.

items.title: 1Password reports a data incident but says user passwords remain safe
items.originalTitle: 2026. 11. 26. Adatvédelmi incidenst jelentett az 1Password, de a felhasználók jelszavai biztonságban vannak Biztonsági incidens érintette az egyik legismertebb jelszókezelő szolgáltatást, az 1Passwor…
items.summary: Password manager 1Password disclosed a security incident; according to the report, stored user passwords were not compromised.

items.title: Law enforcement follow crypto money trail behind billion-euro illegal streaming industry
items.summary: Europol coordinated an 11-country operation in Seville tracing cryptocurrency payments financing illegal IPTV and streaming networks, working with the crypto industry.

items.title: US seizes nearly $17 billion in global war on scam rings
items.summary: The US DOJ announced its largest scam crackdown, seizing nearly $17 billion, with 800+ alleged scammers, 400+ cases and raids on scam compounds in more than 10 countries.

items.title: Estonia closing land borders with Russia to keep out spies
items.summary: Estonia will close its land border crossings with Russia by 1 December, citing the need to keep out spies.

items.title: Zelenskyy warns of major Russian attack as Trump urges Putin to ‘pull back’
items.summary: Zelenskyy warned of a major imminent Russian attack while Trump said he urged Putin to pull back military aggression in Europe.

items.title: Free e-government platform that serves two billion people in ten countries has critical SQL injection bug
items.summary: A critical SQL injection flaw was found in India's DIGIT e-government platform, used in ten countries serving two billion people, potentially exposing citizen data.

items.title: EU leaders brave clash with Trump over tech tax, defense, Ukraine
items.summary: EU governments show increased willingness to confront the US president over tech taxation, defence and Ukraine policy.

items.title: ThreatsDay: 10M NGINX Services at Risk, 250+ Malicious Extensions, AI Server Hijacking + 17 More Stories
items.summary: Threat roundup covering around 10 million exposed NGINX services, 250+ malicious browser extensions, AI server hijacking and credential theft trends.

items.title: FIFA Says It Has Been Victim of a Cyberattack Accessing ‘Personal and Business Information’
items.summary: FIFA confirmed a cyberattack in which personal and business information was accessed; timing and exact data types were not disclosed.

items.title: North Korean launderers turn to little-known crypto services to move Binance haul, say researchers
items.summary: Researchers say North Korean launderers are using little-known crypto services to move funds from the Binance haul.

items.title: 'Significant number of customer records' pwned in Flight Centre Travel Group breach
items.summary: Flight Centre Travel Group confirmed a breach affecting a significant number of customer records, part of a wave of attacks on travel booking systems worldwide.

items.title: Meta Refused to Share Muse for Testing, UK Financial Watchdog Complains
items.summary: The UK FCA says Meta declined joint pre-launch testing of its Muse personal agent, warning that agents create another attack surface as the product rolls out in the UK.

items.title: More people falling victim to holiday shopping scams
items.originalTitle: 2026. 11. 27. Egyre többen esnek áldozatul az ünnepi vásárlási csalásoknak A McAfee új kutatása szerint a tavalyi évhez képest csaknem megduplázódott azoknak az amerikaiaknak az aránya, akik ünnepi v…
items.summary: McAfee research cited by Hungary's NKI says the share of Americans victimised by holiday shopping scams has nearly doubled year-on-year, ahead of the Black Friday peak.

items.title: Operation OPSON XV dismantles food fraud networks, seizing EUR 79 million in counterfeit products
items.summary: Europol's Operation OPSON XV across 57 countries seized EUR 79 million in counterfeit food and drink, with 79 arrests and 18 organised crime groups disrupted.

items.title: Spain’s 2026 election explained in maps and charts
items.summary: Explainer on Spain's 29 November snap general election, the electoral system, parties and key issues.

items.summary: Iran warned over foreign military presence in the Gulf as South Korea prepares an expanded naval role in the region.

items.title: Chinese military tests new Taiwan landing tactics in coastal drills

items.title: How Costa’s budget talks sparked a new crisis
items.summary: Politico briefing on how EU Council President Costa's budget negotiations triggered a new political crisis.

items.title: Bank of England boss warns AI must benefit humans
items.summary: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey said AI needs boundaries and must benefit humans, comparing oversight to raising children.

items.summary: Analysis of what a PP-Vox coalition after Spain's 29 November election would mean for policy areas from data centres to EU relations.

items.title: Budget summit walkout leaves EU one month to salvage deal
items.summary: EU leaders walked out of the budget summit without agreement, leaving one month to salvage a deal amid deep divisions.

items.title: OpenAI warns GPT-6.2 Astra will hit usage limits 40% faster because it fixed a bug
items.summary: OpenAI says a bug that under-counted GPT-6.2 Astra usage has been fixed, so users will reach usage limits 40% faster. Relevant for teams budgeting AI capacity.

items.title: UK privacy watchdog faces probe into its workplace culture
items.summary: The UK ICO faces an independent review of its workplace culture, leadership and handling of staff concerns after the former commissioner resigned.

items.summary: The Bank of England flags growing financial stability risks from surging AI-related borrowing.
